title: Transport for the Malta trip (13–19 October 2026)
intro: Bus-first for flexible daytime travel; compare app-based rides for luggage or a late event exit. Routes 186, 214 and TD1 are candidates, not saved hotel-to-gate journeys. Check the actual date, direction, walks and return before setting out. Published fares below are reference prices, not personal quotes.

records.description: A Hotspawn/Eventbrite listing read 11 October gives BLAST Arena Studios Malta at MFCC South Gate National Stadium, Attard, for 14–18 October 2026 and a Google Maps coordinate. It shows check-in/game agenda entries for 14–16 October only: 09:30/10:30 with a 22:30 end on Wednesday and Thursday, and 14:00/15:00 with a 21:00 end on Friday. records.name: Bus fares, travel cards and where to buy them (operator table, 11 October 2026)
records.address: Tickets may be purchased onboard by cash or contactless; sales points and machines are listed by MPT
records.hours: Tickets are valid for two hours with free transfers inside that window. Missed-ticket penalty: €50. Explore Child 7-day is €7.00 (ages 4–10). Cards and singles are sold at the airport, the Valletta and Buġibba terminals and Sliema Ferries, and the page does not print the 2026/27 winter changeover date.
records.description: The operator’s fare page, read 11 October 2026, publishes a single ticket table and a separate card table. Singles bought from the driver with cash, a contactless bank card or a phone are €2.00 (winter) or €2.50 (summer) on day routes and are valid for two hours with free transfers. The 12 Single Day Journeys card costs €19.00 and is shareable between travellers; the Explore Flex card costs €21.00 for four days or €27.00 for seven days and its offer grid explicitly includes Day Routes, Night Routes, Airport Direct and Special Services; the separate Explore Adult 7-day card at €25.00 explicitly excludes tallinja Direct Routes. A €50 penalty applies to travellers who cannot show a valid ticket, and cards must be validated on boarding. The page states the winter €2.00 single-fare period as running from 19 October 2025 to 13 June 2026, which does not resolve which single fare applies during 13–19 October 2026.
records.notes: Fare page read 11 October 2026: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ . Card-sales locations and machines: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/office-and-ticket-machine/ . TD1 Airport Direct detail: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/other-services/airport-direct/ . Worked comparison for a seven-day trip that includes airport days and daily event travel: Explore Flex 7-day €27.00 already includes Airport Direct, which would otherwise cost TD1 singles at €3.50 each way (€7.00 return); Explore Adult 7-day €25.00 plus two TD1 singles is about €32.00, and a 12-journey €19.00 card would be partly consumed by the two extra Airport Direct journeys. That comparison is arithmetic on published prices, not a quote, and assumes the traveller actually needs Airport Direct and daily buses. The page also sells Explore Flex bundle upgrades that add a Gozo Highspeed return (€42.00 for 7 days) or a harbour cruise (€42.00 for 7 days). Confirm activation, expiry and inclusions at a sales office before buying. Sales offices and ticket machines: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/office-and-ticket-machine/ . The page states that the €2.00 winter fare applied from 19 October 2025 to 13 June 2026 and lists a separate summer day-route fare of €2.50, but it does not print the 2026/27 winter start date, so the exact seasonal boundary for this trip stays open. Recheck the day before travel, because seasonal prices and card inclusions change. Re-read additions from a parallel session on 11 October 2026, folded in: Re-read additions 11 October: the Explore Flex card can also buy two Airport Direct trips for €6; sightseeing bundles are listed at €36/€42 (Gozo Highspeed return or Harbour Cruise, 4/7-day), €53/€59 (2 Islands), €68/€74 (2 Islands + cruise), €53/€59 (Golden Comino Escape, summer only) and €41/€51 (Hop-On Hop-Off); the shareable 12-journey card expires six months after first use and charges Airport Direct/Night at two journeys per trip. Explore Adult versus €27 Explore Flex comparison when Airport Direct is wanted, is worked out in the separate record trip-fare-scenarios-13-19-oct; the seasonal question is handled in mpt-seasonal-fare-window-2026 and sales points in mpt-card-sales-points. This session re-read both chunks of the fare page and the Airport Direct FAQ. The latter uses broader “Unlimited Travel Card” language than the specific Explore Adult exclusion; ask MPT which exact card is accepted on TD1 before paying.
records.price range: On-board/contactless single: €2.00 winter day route, €2.50 summer day route; night route €3.00; Special Service €3.00; tallinja Direct €3.00; TD1 €3.50. Cards: 12 Single Day Journeys €19.00 (shareable); Explore Flex 4-day €21.00 and 7-day €27.00 (both include Day, Night, Airport Direct and Special Services); Explore Adult 7-day €25.00 (excludes tallinja Direct Routes); Explore Child 7-day €7.00.

records.notes: This is a planning sequence assembled from the operator’s own published grids and notices, not a verified door-to-door journey. Underlying sources: Route 186 stop grids https://www.publictransport.com.mt/route/186/ (read 11 October 2026); fares and card inclusions https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ ; service notices https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ ; night-route announcement https://www.publictransport.com.mt/new-night-routes/ ; date-specific planner https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/ . Unverified pieces: the walk from each Qawra stop to AX ODYCY, the walk from Stadium 6227/2194 to the actual MFCC/BLAST gate, the correct side of the road at each stop, and whether Route 186 runs to plan on the specific dates. The service-updates page also lists an October 17–18 notice without a year in the extracted text; confirm its applicability to this trip. Re-run the planner on the day and keep a live Bolt, eCabs, Uber or Malta Taxi quote as the fallback: https://bolt.eu/en/cities/malta/ , https://ecabs.com.mt/ , https://www.uber.com/global/en/r/cities/valletta-valletta-mt/ , https://www.maltataxi.mt/ .
